_comment: ONE registry of the windows the help assistant knows (tab id -> sub-views, documents, the keys its ui_context may carry). The server (help_context.py) and the web tests read this file; every document id listed here needs <id>.en.md and <id>.zh-CN.md next to it. Key kinds: "flag", "count", "code" (a known validation code, help_context.ERROR_CODES), {"enum": [...]} and {"enums": [...]} with EXACT allowed values. Nothing a user typed is ever forwarded: no names, no free text. min_role is the lowest role that gets more than nothing for this tab; anon, user and oem never get more than the tab id (help_context.ID_ONLY_ROLES).
